project_info.theme: Fictional mobile livestream interface for an adult activewear product demonstration
project_info.creative_direction: Natural home livestream frame showing garment fit and stretch through practical movement, not body emphasis
project_info.color_palette: soft gray activewear, warm beige top, cream room, lamp amber, muted pink UI accents, and charcoal text

main_subject.type: clearly adult Asian woman and livestream host
main_subject.detail: friendly adult host with long dark hair and natural smiling expression in a softly lit home setting
main_subject.wardrobe: simple fitted activewear top and gray yoga pants with visible seam and stretch texture
main_subject.action: standing at a comfortable three-quarter angle and making natural movements to demonstrate waistband, seams, stretch, and everyday fit

composition_elements.framing: vertical mobile livestream screen with the host centered in a tidy home interior
composition_elements.ui_overlay: fictional streaming interface with invented host name, generic viewer count, abstract avatars, chat bubbles, hearts, product badge, and placeholder call-to-action; no real platform, personal data, or readable private messages
composition_elements.environment: warm bedroom or home studio with curtains, a floor lamp, clean floor, and uncluttered product-demo space
composition_elements.product_focus: show fabric, seams, waistband, and movement through natural side turns without emphasizing intimate body parts or sexualized curves

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft warm practical lamp at approximately 3200K combined with neutral window fill at 5000K
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: friendly home commerce atmosphere, realistic activewear texture, natural skin detail, and readable but fictional UI

technical_specs.render_style: smartphone livestream capture with 35mm-equivalent perspective and realistic indoor photography
technical_specs.finish: natural motion, visible fabric weave, restrained saturation, clean UI layering, and no beauty-filter smoothing

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical mobile livestream visual featuring a clearly adult Asian woman hosting a fictional activewear product demonstration at home. Show a friendly adult host with long dark hair and a natural smile in a tidy warm bedroom or home studio with curtains and a floor lamp. She wears a simple fitted activewear top and gray yoga pants with visible seam and stretch texture. Have her stand at a comfortable three-quarter angle and make natural movements to demonstrate waistband, seams, fabric stretch, and everyday fit without emphasizing intimate body parts or using a sexualized pose. Add a fictional livestream interface with invented host name, generic viewer count, abstract avatar circles, generic chat bubbles, hearts, a product badge, and placeholder call-to-action. Use no real streaming platform, personal data, private messages, or real logo. Light with a warm approximately 3200K lamp and 5000K window fill, keeping natural skin, realistic fabric, and friendly commerce mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, body-part emphasis, exaggerated curves, real livestream platform, real username, personal data, private messages, logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, distorted UI, illegible chat
